preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect nodes within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n nodes.
The output must be the lexicographically smallest sequence of nodes.
